What is degree in my resume

When referring to your resume, mentioning a "degree" typically means including information about any educational qualifications you have achieved. This could include details such as the name of the university or institution where you obtained your degree, the field of study, and the year(s) in which you graduated.

For example:
- Bachelor of Architecture from Larsen & Toubro Limited, 20XX
